keyword_evidence: Marketplace and classroom-rug sources show buyer demand around reading rugs, classroom library rugs, personalized teacher rugs, handprint classroom rugs and growth-mindset classroom decor. B025 keeps classroom/reading intent clear while separating near-duplicate handprint designs by visible message and motif.
buyer_summary: B025 buyers are teachers, school librarians, daycare owners, homeschool parents and gift buyers looking for soft classroom rugs that define reading corners, circle-time zones and student belonging spaces.
purchase_concerns: Teacher name spelling, classroom message accuracy, visible quote readability, size fit, softness, anti-slip backing, washable/easy-clean expectations, duplicate-looking designs, and matching the rug message to classroom values.
